scope: Load-bearing scalar-center algebra and specified SU(3) probe; analytic limits require report.md.

clifford_square.coverage: all 136 coefficients of each homogeneous quadratic identity
clifford_square.Fierz_identity: sum_i(A_i C_i^t+C_i A_i^t)=(v^t gamma9 v)I-(v^t v)gamma9
clifford_square.T_polarization: T^t=-T; T^2=-I; commutes with gamma1..3 and anticommutes with gamma4..9
clifford_square.quartic_reduction: the only nonmetric coefficient is an alternating four-form; it contracts the invariant-bracket Jacobi identity
clifford_square.undeformed_square: D_v(h,0)^2=1/2 p^2+h^2/2 sum_[i<j]|[x_i,x_j]|^2-(ih/2)theta^t(ad(x_j) tensor gamma_j)theta on gauge invariants

gauge_density.probe: SU(3), partition (2,1), scalar center gap r=2
gauge_density.span: center plus all three Hermitian internal generators of U(2)
gauge_density.general_identity: Tr(J Kq Ke^-1)=Tr(Kq)/delta=0, Ke=delta J, J^2=-I, Kq^t=-Kq
gauge_density.general_proof: substitute Ke^-1=-J/delta and cycle the final J to the front of the trace

graded_inverse.parity: A odd, inverse odd, W even
graded_inverse.probe: the parity-free inverse leaves a sign error on odd slow vectors

not_certified_by_this_script: existence or dimensions of internal BFSS kernels
